COMMERCELAYER_CLIENT_ID.description: The same field name as the sales-channel template beside this one, and the opposite sensitivity. Commerce Layer calls integration and webapp credentials confidential, and confidential is what the second half below makes them.

COMMERCELAYER_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Only confidential credentials are issued one. Its presence is what tells you which kind you are holding, which is why these are two templates rather than one with a footnote.
